housing.summary: Numbeo reports a July 2026 average of EUR 777 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Coimbra city centre; Idealista lists Coimbra rentals, including T1 listings. The deposit norm was not verified.

banking.summary: Millennium bcp permits branch account opening and lists accepted identity, taxpayer-number, address, and professional-status evidence on its official account-help page.
required_docs: valid identity document (Citizen Card, residence permit, passport, or national identity card)
proof of address issued within the previous 12 months
proof of professional status issued within the previous 6 months

schools.summary: An official page from the owner of St Paul's School confirms a Coimbra school offering the Portuguese national curriculum with bilingual Portuguese-English instruction; no IB, British, French, American, or other international curriculum and no schools-directory URL were verified.

legal_admin.summary: For EU, EEA, Andorran, and Swiss nationals staying more than three months, AIMA requires a registration certificate from the municipality for the area of residence.
legal_admin.registration_step: Request the EU registration certificate from Coimbra City Hall within 30 days after the first three months in Portugal.

tax_finance.summary: A foreign citizen may request a Portuguese NIF in person by appointment at a Tax Office or Citizen's Shop, or online through e-balcao via a legal representative, using identity and foreign-address evidence.

transport.summary: Coimbra's SMTUC buses and Metrobus share an intermodal Passe Rede Geral; the reference monthly price is EUR 30 from 1 April 2026.
transport.network_name: SMTUC (Servicos Municipalizados de Transportes Urbanos de Coimbra)
transport.driving_licence_exchange: The rule depends on the issuing country: EU/EEA licences may be used until expiry and residence must be registered with IMT; qualifying OECD/CPLP licences may remain valid under IMT conditions; licences from bilateral-agreement or convention countries have residence-based exchange deadlines. Source: https://www.imt-ip.pt/condutores/informacoes-gerais/quero-ser-condutor/tenho-carta-de-conducao-estrangeira/
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible foreign residents can obtain the National Health Service user number (NNU) through the integrated identification-number service at participating Citizen Spaces by presenting a passport and activating Chave Movel Digital. Source: https://www.acss.min-saude.pt/2025/03/17/acss-reforca-simplificacao-no-acesso-ao-numero-nacional-de-utente-para-cidadaos-estrangeiros/
